title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Terms of Calibration Service and Service Charges
content:
These terms govern calibration work performed under the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan, the units it consumes and the charges it carries. Each charge is billed to the customer's Commercial Credit Account as an invoice under its work order or billing reference.

**1. Plan status.** Calibrations are performed only on a plan whose status is active. The status is read from the company's record of the plan the calibration is booked against, before the calibration is performed. The CalCare Pay-Per-Service tier is a plan with no fee and no prepaid units, so every unit it uses is billed as overage.

**2. Units consumed.** A standard calibration consumes the instrument class's units under the tier's instrument class units. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration consumes those units multiplied by the tier's accredited unit multiplier, rounded up to a whole unit, and is available only for classes in the tier's accredited scope classes. The tier's default certificate type applies when the customer names none.

**3. Prepaid units first.** Prepaid units are used first; units not covered by the prepaid balance are billed at the tier's standard unit price each as overage. The overage amount is the uncovered units multiplied by the standard unit price.

**4. Calibration price.** The calibration price on which the rush fee and the multi-point surcharge are reckoned is the calibration's units multiplied by the tier's standard unit price.

**5. Rush.** A rush calibration beyond the tier's rush calibrations per plan year without the rush fee carries the tier's rush fee percent of the calibration price at the standard unit price per unit. Rush calibrations are counted within the current plan year, up to and including the calibration being charged, in order of calibration date and then work order.

**6. Other charges.** Calibration at more test points than the standard procedure carries the tier's multi-point surcharge percent of that same price. A pickup carries the tier's pickup fee where pickup and delivery are not included. A loaner carries the tier's loaner fee per week per started week, up to the tier's longest loaner period in weeks. A certificate reissue carries the tier's certificate reissue fee.

**7. Results.** As-found readings are reported with the certificate where the tier includes as-found data. Adjustment of an out-of-tolerance instrument is included where the tier includes adjustment, and the customer is notified of an out-of-tolerance as-found result within the tier's out-of-tolerance notice period in business days.

**8. Onsite.** Onsite calibration is booked in days of at least the tier's minimum instruments per onsite day; the tier's included onsite days are included each plan year and each further day carries the tier's onsite day fee.

**9. Shipping to the lab.** Instruments sent to the lab travel on a prepaid label where the tier provides a lab shipping label, and otherwise at the customer's cost.

**10. One charge per type.** Each work order is billed at most once for each charge type. The charge types are plan fee, overage units, rush, multi-point surcharge, pickup, loaner, repair, evaluation, disposal, certificate reissue, onsite day, additional assets and unit top-up. Whether a charge of a type has already been billed is read from the billing entries recorded under the same work order or billing reference and charge type.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, not a tier's published values)

An accredited calibration of a scale or balance (3 class units) on a tier with an accredited multiplier of 1.5, a standard unit price of 60.00 and a rush fee of 40 percent; the plan holds 2 prepaid units, and the calibration is a rush beyond the plan year's rush allowance.

| Quantity | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Units consumed | 3 multiplied by 1.5 is 4.5, rounded up | 5 units |
| From prepaid balance | the 2 units held | 2 units |
| Overage | 3 uncovered units multiplied by 60.00 | 180.00 |
| Calibration price | 5 units multiplied by 60.00 | 300.00 |
| Rush fee | 40 percent of 300.00 | 120.00 |

## Rush count (hypothetical)

On a tier allowing 2 rush calibrations per plan year without the rush fee, the first and second rush calibrations of the plan year carry no rush fee, and the third and every later rush calibration in that plan year carries it. Two rush calibrations on the same date are taken in work order order.

## Loaner weeks (hypothetical)

A loaner kept 10 days spans 2 started weeks and carries the weekly loaner fee twice, within the tier's longest loaner period.
